text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Bamboo Memory and Mejiro
Ardan one
day while I'm passing by the
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you again for helping me move all
these
books. You're a real lifesaver. I
shouldn't have
borrowed so many.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It was no problem at all! You can come
to me any
time you need help!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aw, thanks! But the day's just getting
started! I'm
going to help out loads
more!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After all... I'm planning on doing
sixty-four good
deeds today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's how it started, but then I started
doubling
it! Two, four, eight! ...Sixteen!
Um... thirty-two?
Yeah, thirty-two!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, uh, uhhh... anyway! Sixty-four after a
week!
Wouldn't it be cool if I could pull
it off? Not to
mention awesome!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I have to hurry or I won't be able to
finish in
time! See you later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She leaves before I can stop her, so I can
only
look on with concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that evening, I find Bamboo
Memory on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for all the trouble, Bamboo!
Thanks for
helpin' me pass all that stuff
out to the younger
students!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No worries! I'm glad to be of help!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I can always count on you.
Y'know, I've
heard you've been extra
helpful recently.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not that I don't 'preciate it, but isn't it
tough?
Since you're always helpin' me
out, I'll lend a hand
if you want!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I'm okay! I appreciate the offer, but
this is
something I'd like to do on my
own!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
When I became the chair of the
disciplinary
committee, my father gave
me a talk about the
resolve you need to
maintain order and discipline.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
So you've become the disciplinary
committee
chair? Nicely done! Here's a
piece of advice that
I've learned from
teaching.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
The first thing to know about keeping
everyone in
line is... you need to be the
coolest person
around!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Anyone with a bit of nerve can yell at
people
when they're misbehaving, but
you're not going
to change many hearts
that way.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's why you have to be a role model
if you
really want to keep order. You've
got to be so
cool that everyone wants to
be like you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see! That way, everyone will follow the
rules all
by themselves!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've been trying to think
up some
special training I can do right
away to become a
role model.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Going to bed and waking up early all
year round,
keeping the bathroom
spotless, chewing every
bite of food
twenty times... and now, my week of

doubling good deeds!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got the idea from a show I watched way
back,
where a character said, "Always
strive to be
better than you were
yesterday." It's the best
training I've ever
done!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And out of my goal of sixty-four, this
makes
sixty-three! Just one more to go!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So that's why you've been workin'
so hard.
Guess it'd be rude if I got in
your way.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, get out there and finish it
yourself! Do
that and I reckon you'll be a
great role model!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Right! I appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer! You caught me with just
one good
deed left to go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But the thing is, I've already helped
everyone at
the academy. I've only got
one good deed left,
but I don't know if I
can find anyone who needs
anything.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
That's right! I never thought about
that! A good
deed can still be good
even if it doesn't help
someone!
choice_data_list: “善”は相手がいないと行えないものか？
“善”って相手がいないと行えないもの？

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Something cool... What's the coolest
thing I could
do as a role model for the
other students?
choice_data_list: 君がカッコいいと思える行いが答えだ
貴方がカッコいいと思える行いが答えだよ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I've got it! Training! Red-hot training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! This one is gonna bring it
home! What
kind of training should I do
for my final good
deed?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! This one is gonna bring it
home! What
kind of training should I do
for my final good
deed?!
choice_data_list: 心のおもむくままに筋トレ！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Right on! I'm gonna turn every inch
of flesh
into cold-hard steel!
choice_data_list: 心のおもむくままに筋トレ！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Hyah! ...HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Student
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's some workout! She's going
so hard,
she's shaking the building!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory successfully achieves
her goal
and becomes a real role model
for the students of
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll show the whole academy what
an
amazing run looks like!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
RAAAH! I'll finish things off with
sixty-four full
speed laps!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Student
text_block_list.text:
What an intense run!
Hey, everyone! Are
we just gonna sit back and be
outdone?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I gave it everything I had! I managed to hold out till the very end, even with the others hot on my heels!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory successfully achieves
her goal
and becomes a real role model
for the students of
Tracen Academy.
